svg.text: Medication or exposure at any visit: what to check

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • WHEN: weeks 1–2 insensitive · weeks 3–8 (organogenesis) → MAJOR anomalies · later → function + minor anomalies

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • WHAT: radiation, hyperthermia · TORCH infections · maternal diabetes · drugs, herbals, recreational drugs, toxins

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) category: A human studies safe · D human risk, benefit may win · X risk

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
